messages:
alex: quick sync: proposing X-Route-Intent header so clients can hint preferred pool and priority. want SDK compatibility notes and console telemetry plan.
tara: wire format? prefer compact key=value; pairs over JSON.
sahil: agree compact. suggest canonical order: prio,pool,src. runtime treats it as a hint only.
vivian: console needs both requested vs applied columns. initial ingestion should sample the header raw string to avoid schema churn.
ops-bot: infra-check: proxy passthrough update required for header (PR #5123).
tara: semver: add optional RouteIntent param in patch release; emit header in minor release so clients can opt in safely.
sahil: we'll add encoder helpers in ts/go. python will add a small dataclass with to_wire().
alex: rollout: week1 spec + SDK stubs, week3 internal canary with sampled telemetry, week6 tenant opt-in for attribution, week12 evaluate flip for new tenants.
vivian: will mock dashboard tile and sampling toggle. include "requested matches applied" quick status in route detail.
tara: i'll draft TS/Go issues and ABNF for header chars. sahil: i'll start py PR with unit tests for escaping.
alex: thanks all, posting spec doc after thread. :thumbsup:
